messages:
jen: Zephyr POC hitting errors on rerank and rate limits. Two things: dims mismatch and 429s when they spike. Paste log and sample.

jen: log: `ERROR rerank: embedding dims 256 != index dims 512`

jen: sample payload: {"query_embedding": [...256 floats...], "candidates": [[...256 floats...]]}

priya: Did they reindex with the same encoder? Ask which encoder/version made the stored index.

jen: They used an older internal encoder (256-dim) for stored vectors; app now calls redwood-embed-3 (512-dim). They missed the requirement to match dims.

marco: Quick mitigation: offer conversion shim that upsamples 256->512 (pad + learned linear transform) but warn about score drift. Recommend reindex with redwood-embed-3.

jen: Also 429s: they reported ~220 rps sustained, peaks ~480rps with many small batches (size=4). Error: `429 rate_limit_exceeded`.

priya: I'll open an escalation for a temporary POC bump. Need an exact window.

ops-bot: Escalation ticket SE-2026-058 opened for Zephyr rate bump. Assigned to priya. ETA 3h.

marco: Short term actions: (1) temp rate increase for 48h to 500 rps (priya), (2) run our validate-index endpoint to report mismatches, (3) run a 10k sample reindex and share quality delta.

jen: validate example: `curl -d '{"index_id":"zephyr-prod","expected_dim":512}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/internal/validate-index` -> `{"ok":false,"mismatch_count":342,"expected_dim":512,"observed_dim":256}`

priya: I'll coordinate PS/Dedicated pricing for a full reindex (estimate ~5M docs) and share security pack for their SOC2 questions.

marco: I'll draft a short python pad/snippet for migration and include Optimize eval guidance.

jen: thanks team. tagging @zephyr-poc in the ticket. :thumbsup:
